head: YouTube TV support scam: fake phone number on Google cost a viewer thousands
dek: A YouTube TV viewer in North Carolina lost several thousand dollars after calling a fake support number found on Google, the McDowell County Sheriff's Office says. The caller was told to buy Lowe's gift cards.
details: It started with a message while watching YouTube TV saying the debit card details needed updating; it's unclear whether that message was real. The person searched Google for a support number and called the first one, which reached a scammer.
means: If you search for a company's support number, the first result may be a scammer, not the company.
todo: Contact support only through the official YouTube TV app or website. Anyone who asks you to pay with gift cards or share their numbers or PINs is a scammer. Never give passwords, codes or bank details to a caller you haven't verified.
